name: PP-OCR Text Reader
description: Turn the camera into a tireless data-entry clerk: meter readings, container codes, shipping labels, station tags — point and read, in Chinese and English, with results flowing straight into your system. No more manual transcription.
description_zh: 把摄像头变成不知疲倦的“录入员”：仪表读数、集装箱号、面单编号、工位标签，对准即读、中英文皆可，识别结果直接进系统，告别人工抄录和录入错误。
author: Seeed Studio
